orientation.basis: All prominent Latin text has horizontal baselines and reads left-to-right without rotation; the long panel edges are horizontal and the central forms have vertical axes.

blindPixelObservations: Portrait frame with a dark maroon, brown, and black textured background; warm orange-white illumination is concentrated near the upper center.
Two bulky, dark, upright figure-like silhouettes occupy the center-right. A chain-like dark line crosses the upper region, and a tilted red rectangular placard appears at upper left.
The upper-left placard has a light border, one large white text line, a middle row of pale-yellow block-like marks, and a much smaller blurred pale line near its bottom edge.
A compact blue-white composite glyph followed by a white alphanumeric mark is centered immediately above a wide, dark, beveled title plaque.
The lower portion contains a narrow charcoal title plaque overlapping a larger dark body panel. Both have thin cream/orange outlines, clipped corners, and projecting side details.

Typography is predominantly off-white. The title and separator are uppercase; the body is mixed case; the word NOT and the A in Section A are visibly emphasized. The lowest centered line is orange uppercase text.
Mirrored orange-and-cream diagonal accents are integrated into the left and right edges of the large lower panel; they resemble glyphs but are visually continuous with the border treatment.

iconMorphology.location: Upper center, directly left of 3+ and immediately above THE SUPPLY ROUTE.
iconMorphology.outerShape: Unenclosed composite consisting of two or three low, wide concentric horizontal ovals with a narrow upright form rising from their center; the upright form has a rounded cap, constricted middle, and wider base.
iconMorphology.internalMarks: Bright white central core with pale-cyan edging; dark separations occur between the blue oval rings, whose rims carry cyan highlights.
iconMorphology.neighboringText: 3+ immediately to the right; THE SUPPLY ROUTE directly below.
iconMorphology.closestPlausibleAlternative: A pointed flame- or beacon-like vertical mark above ripple-like ovals.
iconMorphology.visibleDiscriminator: The visible top is rounded rather than pointed, while the lower blue elements remain distinctly separated horizontal ovals.

iconMorphology.location: Upper-left red placard, middle row below CARGO-045.
iconMorphology.outerShape: Two horizontally elongated pale-yellow rounded blocks followed at the far right by a small wedge with an acute right-facing point.
iconMorphology.internalMarks: The right elongated block contains a small red/dark interruption; the pointed wedge appears solid and has no legible internal character.
iconMorphology.neighboringText: CARGO-045 above; a small [illegible] printed line below.
iconMorphology.closestPlausibleAlternative: Two blank rectangular fields with a decorative triangular notch rather than a unified symbol sequence.
iconMorphology.visibleDiscriminator: The far-right element terminates in a discrete acute point, whereas the preceding two elements retain rounded rectangular silhouettes.

iconMorphology.location: Mirrored along the left and right sides of the large lower text panel.
iconMorphology.outerShape: Paired black projecting border housings, each containing several short, parallel, slanted orange-and-cream strokes.
iconMorphology.internalMarks: Two or three nested diagonal bars per side, with thin pale highlights and no lettering.
iconMorphology.neighboringText: They flank the lower body text, including AND and The Facility must NOT be destroyed.
iconMorphology.closestPlausibleAlternative: Independent paired chevron-like controls rather than decorative panel-border accents.
iconMorphology.visibleDiscriminator: Both clusters are bilaterally mirrored and physically continuous with the beveled panel outline rather than isolated in separate enclosures.

readConfidence.materialText: High for 3+, CARGO-045, the title, all main body text, and MISSION TASK; very low for the tiny bottom line on the red placard.
readConfidence.punctuation: High for the hyphen in CARGO-045, the plus sign in 3+, both parentheses, and the full stops after C and destroyed; unresolved within the illegible placard line.
readConfidence.iconMorphology: Medium-high for the central blue-white glyph, medium for the blurred placard marks, and high for the visible shape of the panel-side motifs but low that those motifs are functional.

classificationConfidence.componentFamily: High for a card-like printed component based on layout alone; no external family taxonomy is asserted.
classificationConfidence.exactComponent: Medium: the literal title and MISSION TASK label are clear, but canonical identity and icon meanings cannot be established from these pixels alone.

uncertainties: The small lower line on the upper-left red placard cannot be reliably segmented into characters and remains [illegible].
The central blue-white glyph could visually resemble either a rounded upright figure-like form or a flame/beacon-like form; no printed label establishes its identity.
The pale-yellow marks on the red placard may be indicators, blank fields, or decorative shapes; their function is not visibly established.
The mirrored orange side motifs appear integrated with the panel border, but a functional chevron-like reading cannot be completely excluded.
The final C. is visibly printed, but the image alone does not establish whether C is an abbreviation, identifier, or part of a longer naming convention.
MISSION TASK appears once at lower center; it is represented in both typeLine and lowerCenter to encode its apparent role and its visible position, not as two separate printed instances.
